title: Common definitions
description: Shared building blocks referenced by every other v1 contract. Contains $defs only and validates nothing on its own.

id_segment.description: Lower-case identifier segment: a letter, then letters, digits or underscores, at most 48 characters.

action_id.description: Action identifier inside a pack: 2 to 4 dot-separated segments, e.g. 'oven.set_zone_temp'.

env_name.description: Name of an environment variable that holds a value (often a secret). Manifests carry the name, never the value.

semver.description: Semantic Version 2.0 core with optional pre-release, e.g. '1.4.0' or '0.3.0-rc.1'.

uuid.description: RFC 9562 UUID in canonical lower-case hyphenated form.

sha256_hex.description: SHA-256 digest as 64 lower-case hex characters.

trace_id.description: W3C trace-context trace id: 32 lower-case hex characters.

timestamp.description: RFC 3339 date-time in UTC; must end in 'Z'.

risk.description: Risk tier of an action. high/critical never execute without human approval.

autonomy.description: Autonomy level: L0 observe, L1 advise, L2 propose (human approves), L3 act within envelope, L4 exception-only.

actor.description: Who did something: a human, an agent, a pack binding, or the system itself.

id.description: Stable identifier of the actor within its kind.

taint_source.description: Origin of a context item. Only 'user' and 'system' may authorize; the rest is data.

cel_expr.description: Common Expression Language expression. Parsed and evaluated from P2 on; stored as text here.

reason.description: Machine-readable code plus a human-readable message.
